decision.reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both answers are valid for “continue” and the English cue/sense are aligned. However, the proposed contrast “different-common-word” is misleading: melanjutkan and meneruskan are established synonyms across Indonesian and Malaysian Malay, so this is not a reliable variety-specific distinction or false-friend contrast. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
